sampleMaterials.name: algebra-syllabus.txt
sampleMaterials.text: Quadratic equations and factorization are core algebra topics. Students should solve equations by factoring, completing the square, and using the quadratic formula. Functions, domain, and range are key range-check skills for exams.

sampleMaterials.name: biology-notes.txt
sampleMaterials.text: Genetics includes dominant and recessive traits. Meiosis halves the chromosome number and produces haploid cells. Cell division and human physiology are important exam topics.
